Executive rber.
The appointment of Mr. Edgar Mabie as Superintendent of the Bureau of
WVar Risk Insurance in the Treasury D~epartment is hereby authorized without
compliance with Civil Service rules.
Trhis order is issued on the recommendation of the Secretary of the Treasury,
who states that Mr. Maie has had fourteen years' experience in one of the large
insurance companies in New York City, passing on applications for insurance,
examining policies, and having supervision of general office detail, and in view
of the technical character of the work in the Bureau of War Risk Insurance, for
which specially trained assistants are required, it is believed his appointment
will be greatly in the interests of the service.
